## Adaptive Rejection Sampling (ARS)
## Implementation of Gilks, W. R., & Wild, P. (1992).
## "Adaptive rejection sampling for Gibbs sampling."
## Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series C, 41(2), 337-348.
##
## Public interface:
##   ars(density_function, domain, n = sample_count)
##   test()
##
## The algorithm samples from a univariate density whose logarithm is
## concave.  It maintains an upper hull (piecewise-linear tangents to the
## log-density) and a lower hull (chords) that are refined adaptively as
## points are accepted.  Log-concavity is checked continuously; a
## violation raises an informative error.

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Auxiliary function: numerical derivative of a scalar function
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.deriv <- function(h, x, eps = 1e-6) {
  ## Central finite difference of h at the point(s) x.
  scale <- pmax(abs(x), 1)
  dx <- eps * scale
  (h(x + dx) - h(x - dx)) / (2 * dx)
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Auxiliary function: build the log-density and its derivative
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.make_logdensity <- function(density_function) {
  ## Returns a list with h (log density) and hprime (its derivative).
  h <- function(x) {
    val <- density_function(x)
    if (length(val) != length(x))
      stop("density_function must be vectorized (return one value per input)")
    if (any(!is.finite(val) & val != 0))
      stop("density_function returned non-finite values")
    lv <- rep(-Inf, length(x))
    pos <- val > 0
    lv[pos] <- log(val[pos])
    lv
  }
  hprime <- function(x) .deriv(h, x)
  list(h = h, hprime = hprime)
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Auxiliary function: initialise the abscissae T_k
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.init_abscissae <- function(h, hprime, domain) {
  lower <- domain[1]
  upper <- domain[2]

  ## Pick a finite interior anchor.
  if (is.finite(lower) && is.finite(upper)) {
    anchor <- (lower + upper) / 2
  } else if (is.finite(lower)) {
    anchor <- lower + 1
  } else if (is.finite(upper)) {
    anchor <- upper - 1
  } else {
    anchor <- 0
  }

  ## Left starting point: needs positive derivative when lower == -Inf.
  if (is.finite(lower)) {
    x_left <- lower + 1e-3 * max(abs(lower), 1)
  } else {
    x_left <- anchor
    step <- 1
    tries <- 0
    while ((!is.finite(h(x_left)) || hprime(x_left) <= 0) && tries < 200) {
      x_left <- x_left - step
      step <- step * 1.3
      tries <- tries + 1
    }
    if (hprime(x_left) <= 0)
      stop("Could not find a starting point with positive log-density slope; ",
           "check the domain or the density.")
  }

  ## Right starting point: needs negative derivative when upper == Inf.
  if (is.finite(upper)) {
    x_right <- upper - 1e-3 * max(abs(upper), 1)
  } else {
    x_right <- anchor
    step <- 1
    tries <- 0
    while ((!is.finite(h(x_right)) || hprime(x_right) >= 0) && tries < 200) {
      x_right <- x_right + step
      step <- step * 1.3
      tries <- tries + 1
    }
    if (hprime(x_right) >= 0)
      stop("Could not find a starting point with negative log-density slope; ",
           "check the domain or the density.")
  }

  if (x_left >= x_right) {
    mid <- (x_left + x_right) / 2
    x_left <- mid - 0.5
    x_right <- mid + 0.5
  }

  ## Three points give a better initial hull.
  x_mid <- (x_left + x_right) / 2
  x <- sort(unique(c(x_left, x_mid, x_right)))
  x[is.finite(h(x))]
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Auxiliary function: intersection abscissae z_j of the upper hull
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.compute_z <- function(x, hx, hpx, domain) {
  k <- length(x)
  z <- numeric(k + 1)
  z[1] <- domain[1]
  z[k + 1] <- domain[2]
  if (k >= 2) {
    for (j in 1:(k - 1)) {
      denom <- hpx[j] - hpx[j + 1]
      if (abs(denom) < 1e-12)
        stop("Log-concavity violated: tangent slopes are non-decreasing ",
             "(density is not log-concave).")
      z[j + 1] <- (hx[j + 1] - hx[j] - x[j + 1] * hpx[j + 1] +
                   x[j] * hpx[j]) / denom
    }
  }
  z
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Auxiliary function: evaluate the upper hull u_k(x)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.upper_hull <- function(xs, x, hx, hpx, z) {
  ## Segment index: xs lies in [z_j, z_{j+1}] -> tangent at x_j.
  j <- findInterval(xs, z, rightmost.closed = TRUE)
  j <- pmin(pmax(j, 1), length(x))
  hx[j] + (xs - x[j]) * hpx[j]
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Auxiliary function: evaluate the lower hull l_k(x)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.lower_hull <- function(xs, x, hx) {
  k <- length(x)
  if (xs < x[1] || xs > x[k]) return(-Inf)
  j <- findInterval(xs, x, rightmost.closed = TRUE)
  j <- min(max(j, 1), k - 1)
  ((x[j + 1] - xs) * hx[j] + (xs - x[j]) * hx[j + 1]) / (x[j + 1] - x[j])
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Auxiliary function: sample one point from the upper-hull envelope
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.sample_upper <- function(x, hx, hpx, z) {
  k <- length(x)
  hmax <- max(hx)

  ## Per-segment (unnormalised) areas under exp(u_k).
  uL <- hx + (z[1:k]     - x) * hpx - hmax   # value of shifted u at left break
  uR <- hx + (z[2:(k+1)] - x) * hpx - hmax   # value of shifted u at right break

  area <- numeric(k)
  flat <- abs(hpx) < 1e-12
  ## Non-flat segments.
  area[!flat] <- (exp(uR[!flat]) - exp(uL[!flat])) / hpx[!flat]
  ## Flat segments (need finite breakpoints).
  if (any(flat))
    area[flat] <- exp(uL[flat]) * (z[2:(k+1)][flat] - z[1:k][flat])

  if (any(!is.finite(area)) || any(area < 0))
    stop("Envelope has infinite area; the density may not be log-concave ",
         "or is improper on the given domain.")

  total <- sum(area)
  seg <- sample.int(k, size = 1, prob = area / total)

  ## Invert the CDF inside the chosen segment.
  w <- runif(1) * area[seg]
  if (flat[seg]) {
    xs <- z[seg] + w / exp(uL[seg])
  } else {
    inner <- exp(uL[seg]) + w * hpx[seg]
    xs <- x[seg] + (log(inner) + hmax - hx[seg]) / hpx[seg]
  }
  xs
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Auxiliary function: verify log-concavity of the current abscissae
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.check_concavity <- function(hpx) {
  ## Tangent slopes must be non-increasing for a log-concave density.
  if (length(hpx) >= 2) {
    d <- diff(hpx)
    if (any(d > 1e-7))
      stop("Log-concavity violated: the log-density has an increasing ",
           "derivative (density is not log-concave).")
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Auxiliary function: input validation
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.validate_inputs <- function(density_function, domain, n) {
  if (!is.function(density_function))
    stop("density_function must be a function.")
  if (length(domain) != 2 || !is.numeric(domain))
    stop("domain must be a numeric vector of length 2, e.g. c(-Inf, Inf).")
  if (any(is.na(domain)))
    stop("domain must not contain NA.")
  if (domain[1] >= domain[2])
    stop("domain[1] must be strictly less than domain[2].")
  if (length(n) != 1 || !is.numeric(n) || is.na(n))
    stop("n must be a single number.")
  if (n <= 0)
    stop("n must be a positive number of samples.")
  if (n != as.integer(n))
    stop("n must be a whole number.")
  invisible(TRUE)
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Primary function: adaptive rejection sampler
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ars <- function(density_function, domain = c(-Inf, Inf), n = 100) {
  .validate_inputs(density_function, domain, n)
  n <- as.integer(n)

  ld <- .make_logdensity(density_function)
  h <- ld$h
  hprime <- ld$hprime

  x <- .init_abscissae(h, hprime, domain)
  hx <- h(x)
  hpx <- hprime(x)
  .check_concavity(hpx)

  samples <- numeric(n)
  accepted <- 0L
  max_iter <- 1000L * n + 1000L
  iter <- 0L

  while (accepted < n) {
    iter <- iter + 1L
    if (iter > max_iter)
      stop("Sampler failed to reach the requested number of samples; ",
           "the density may be numerically ill-behaved.")

    z <- .compute_z(x, hx, hpx, domain)
    xstar <- .sample_upper(x, hx, hpx, z)

    if (!is.finite(xstar) || xstar < domain[1] || xstar > domain[2])
      next

    w <- runif(1)
    u_val <- .upper_hull(xstar, x, hx, hpx, z)
    l_val <- .lower_hull(xstar, x, hx)

    ## Squeezing test (cheap, avoids evaluating h).
    if (log(w) <= l_val - u_val) {
      accepted <- accepted + 1L
      samples[accepted] <- xstar
      next
    }

    ## Rejection test (evaluate the log-density).
    h_val <- h(xstar)
    if (h_val - u_val > 1e-7)
      stop("Log-concavity violated: sampled point lies above the upper ",
           "hull (density is not log-concave).")

    if (log(w) <= h_val - u_val) {
      accepted <- accepted + 1L
      samples[accepted] <- xstar
    }

    ## Adapt: add xstar to the abscissae set.
    if (is.finite(h_val)) {
      hp_star <- hprime(xstar)
      ins <- findInterval(xstar, x) + 1L
      x <- append(x, xstar, after = ins - 1L)
      hx <- append(hx, h_val, after = ins - 1L)
      hpx <- append(hpx, hp_star, after = ins - 1L)
      .check_concavity(hpx)
    }
  }

  samples
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Test function: formal testing against known distributions
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
test <- function() {
  cat("=========================================================\n")
  cat("Adaptive Rejection Sampling -- formal test suite\n")
  cat("=========================================================\n\n")

  passed <- 0L
  failed <- 0L
  report <- function(name, ok, extra = "") {
    status <- if (ok) "PASS" else "FAIL"
    cat(sprintf("%s: %s %s\n", name, status, extra))
    if (ok) passed <<- passed + 1L else failed <<- failed + 1L
  }

  set.seed(42)

  ## --- Test 1: Standard normal --------------------------------------------
  cat("[Test 1] Sampling from a standard Normal(0,1) ...\n")
  s1 <- ars(function(x) dnorm(x), domain = c(-Inf, Inf), n = 5000)
  m1 <- mean(s1); sd1 <- sd(s1)
  ks1 <- suppressWarnings(ks.test(s1, "pnorm"))$p.value
  cat(sprintf("  mean = %.4f (target 0.0), sd = %.4f (target 1.0), KS p = %.3f\n",
              m1, sd1, ks1))
  report("NORMAL", abs(m1) < 0.1 && abs(sd1 - 1) < 0.1 && ks1 > 0.01,
         sprintf("| mean=%.4f sd=%.4f", m1, sd1))
  write.table(s1, "/app/normal_samples.txt", row.names = FALSE,
              col.names = FALSE)

  ## --- Test 2: Exponential(rate = 1) --------------------------------------
  cat("\n[Test 2] Sampling from an Exponential(rate=1) ...\n")
  s2 <- ars(function(x) dexp(x, rate = 1), domain = c(0, Inf), n = 5000)
  m2 <- mean(s2); sd2 <- sd(s2)
  ks2 <- suppressWarnings(ks.test(s2, "pexp"))$p.value
  cat(sprintf("  mean = %.4f (target 1.0), sd = %.4f (target 1.0), KS p = %.3f\n",
              m2, sd2, ks2))
  report("EXPONENTIAL", abs(m2 - 1) < 0.1 && abs(sd2 - 1) < 0.1 && ks2 > 0.01,
         sprintf("| mean=%.4f sd=%.4f", m2, sd2))
  write.table(s2, "/app/exponential_samples.txt", row.names = FALSE,
              col.names = FALSE)

  ## --- Test 3: Normal(mean=5, sd=2) ---------------------------------------
  cat("\n[Test 3] Sampling from a Normal(5,2) ...\n")
  s3 <- ars(function(x) dnorm(x, mean = 5, sd = 2), domain = c(-Inf, Inf),
            n = 5000)
  m3 <- mean(s3); sd3 <- sd(s3)
  cat(sprintf("  mean = %.4f (target 5.0), sd = %.4f (target 2.0)\n", m3, sd3))
  report("NORMAL_SHIFTED", abs(m3 - 5) < 0.2 && abs(sd3 - 2) < 0.2,
         sprintf("| mean=%.4f sd=%.4f", m3, sd3))

  ## --- Test 4: Gamma(shape=3, rate=1) (log-concave for shape>=1) ----------
  cat("\n[Test 4] Sampling from a Gamma(shape=3, rate=1) ...\n")
  s4 <- ars(function(x) dgamma(x, shape = 3, rate = 1), domain = c(0, Inf),
            n = 5000)
  m4 <- mean(s4); sd4 <- sd(s4)
  cat(sprintf("  mean = %.4f (target 3.0), sd = %.4f (target 1.732)\n",
              m4, sd4))
  report("GAMMA", abs(m4 - 3) < 0.2 && abs(sd4 - sqrt(3)) < 0.2,
         sprintf("| mean=%.4f sd=%.4f", m4, sd4))

  ## --- Test 5: Beta(2,2) on (0,1) -----------------------------------------
  cat("\n[Test 5] Sampling from a Beta(2,2) on (0,1) ...\n")
  s5 <- ars(function(x) dbeta(x, 2, 2), domain = c(0, 1), n = 5000)
  m5 <- mean(s5); sd5 <- sd(s5)
  cat(sprintf("  mean = %.4f (target 0.5), sd = %.4f (target 0.2236)\n",
              m5, sd5))
  report("BETA", abs(m5 - 0.5) < 0.05 && abs(sd5 - sqrt(0.05)) < 0.05,
         sprintf("| mean=%.4f sd=%.4f", m5, sd5))

  ## --- Test 6: unnormalised density ---------------------------------------
  cat("\n[Test 6] Sampling from an UNnormalised Normal kernel ...\n")
  s6 <- ars(function(x) 17.3 * exp(-x^2 / 2), domain = c(-Inf, Inf), n = 5000)
  m6 <- mean(s6); sd6 <- sd(s6)
  cat(sprintf("  mean = %.4f (target 0.0), sd = %.4f (target 1.0)\n", m6, sd6))
  report("UNNORMALISED", abs(m6) < 0.1 && abs(sd6 - 1) < 0.1,
         sprintf("| mean=%.4f sd=%.4f", m6, sd6))

  ## --- Test 7: input validation -------------------------------------------
  cat("\n[Test 7] Input validation (should reject bad inputs) ...\n")
  bad_ok <- TRUE
  chk <- function(expr) inherits(try(expr, silent = TRUE), "try-error")
  bad_ok <- bad_ok && chk(ars(dnorm, c(-Inf, Inf), n = -5))    # negative n
  bad_ok <- bad_ok && chk(ars(dnorm, c(-Inf, Inf), n = 0))     # zero n
  bad_ok <- bad_ok && chk(ars(dnorm, c(1, 1), n = 10))         # bad domain
  bad_ok <- bad_ok && chk(ars(dnorm, c(5, -5), n = 10))        # reversed
  bad_ok <- bad_ok && chk(ars("not a function", c(0, 1), 10))  # not function
  bad_ok <- bad_ok && chk(ars(dnorm, c(-Inf, Inf), n = 2.5))   # non-integer
  report("INPUT_VALIDATION", bad_ok)

  ## --- Test 8: non-log-concave detection ----------------------------------
  cat("\n[Test 8] Detecting a NON-log-concave density (Student-t) ...\n")
  ## The t-distribution with few df has heavy tails and is not log-concave.
  caught <- chk(ars(function(x) dt(x, df = 1), domain = c(-Inf, Inf),
                    n = 2000))
  report("NON_LOG_CONCAVE", caught)

  cat("\n=========================================================\n")
  cat(sprintf("SUMMARY: %d passed, %d failed\n", passed, failed))
  cat("=========================================================\n")
  invisible(list(passed = passed, failed = failed))
}

## Auto-run the test suite when executed via Rscript.
if (sys.nframe() == 0 && !interactive()) {
  test()
}
